definitions.shape: Overall lesion geometry and defining contour; center-only activation is insufficient.
definitions.margin: A meaningful lesion–tissue interface segment, with the source lesion contour as anatomical anchor.
definitions.halo: Immediately external peripheral rim; internal rings and boundary-only activation are insufficient. Negative cases indicate inspection guidance only.
definitions.calcifications: Independently visible plausible discrete bright foci; source labels do not identify pixels. U means no focus can be resolved.
